messages:
Alex (Sales): quick heads-up — NovusHealth asked for a per-token override for hosted API during a 3mo POC, plus min-charge waiver for months 1-2. wants fast turnaround :pray:
Mira (Finance): 30% off? that sounds steep. do we have their usage forecast? need numbers to model impact.
Alex (Sales): roughs from their infra lead: month1 2M tokens, month2 8M, month3 20M. steady state if convert ~20M/mo. conversion ARR ~ $1.2M.
Jon (SRE): capacity note — bursts ok, sustained 20M/mo is fine on hosted but could need extra pool if they push parallel QPS. not blocking the pricing call.
Sam (CS): they're health org, HIPAA in scope. leaning hosted because they want quick pilot. security questionnaire still pending.
Priya (RevOps): Deal Desk rules: discounts >25% or any min-charge waive must go through RevOps + Finance sign-off. I'll open ticket. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-1123
deal-desk-bot: New Deal Desk ticket DD-1123 created by Priya (RevOps). Please add required docs.
Alex (Sales): proposal idea: 25% off per-token for first 3 months, waive month1 min-charge, 50% min-charge for month2, offer 12mo conversion commit for discounted enterprise rates. is that approvable?
Mira (Finance): conditional approval path: 20% discount first 3 months OR 25% if they sign a 9-12mo conversion commit with minimum committed spend. Also require promo cap: $30k total across POC. security checklist complete before go-live.
Jon (SRE): technically fine. if we give deeper discount, recommend routing them to quantized model variant during POC; saves cost for us but may change latency/quality. document tradeoffs to customer.
Sam (CS): I'll get the security questionnaire prioritized and request SOC/HIPAA artifacts. will also push legal for an LOI with conversion clause.
Priya (RevOps): I'll attach the financial model to DD-1123 and tag @Mira (Finance). need final ok from Mira + sign-off from Legal. please add exact token ceilings per month in the ticket.
Mira (Finance): approve conditional on: signed LOI with conversion clause, security artifacts in place, and promo cap. if any of those fail, no waive. :thumbsup:
Alex (Sales): thanks — I'll update customer: offer the 20% baseline with option to move to 25% if they commit to 9-12mo. pushing for LOI now. Sam, ping me when questionnaire is uploaded.
Sam (CS): will do, ETA EOD tomorrow.
Priya (RevOps): I'm adding the final pricing rows in the ticket. once legal drafts conversion clause, @Mira (Finance) will sign. closing loop soon.
